categories.name: Null Reviews
categories.definition: Reviews that lack specific complaints, technical details, or operational context, providing only generic sentiment, brief praise, or uninformative criticism.
include_when: Review consists solely of short generic criticisms or praise (e.g., 'worst app', 'bad', 'waste', 'good app')
Review contains gibberish, single words, or ratings-only sentiment without actionable detail
exclude_when: Review mentions a specific feature, bug, error message, UI element, or transport operational problem
example_phrases: worst app
bad
bekar
waste
rubbish app
worst experience ever
good app
bhot bekar hai
categories.boundary_notes: Reserved strictly for non-actionable reviews where no specific technical or service root cause is identifiable.

categories.name: Authentication and OTP Issues
categories.definition: Problems related to logging in, receiving one-time passwords across communication channels, or retaining login sessions.
include_when: Failure or delay in receiving OTP via SMS, email, or WhatsApp for login or verification
User is unable to log in, verify credentials, or complete account sign-in
App repeatedly and unexpectedly logs the user out, requiring repeated re-authentication
exclude_when: UI overlay issues where an in-ride OTP is obscured by a seatbelt safety modal
App crashing or closing before the login screen is displayed
example_phrases: app is not sending otp
not receiving the OTP
unable to login
it logs out every time
Both Mobile Otp and Email OTP options are not working
every time it requires login
categories.boundary_notes: Focuses on credential verification and session persistence; in-transit OTP display bugs belong to UI_FRICTION_AND_MANDATORY_PROMPTS.

categories.name: App Crashes and Launch Failures
categories.definition: Technical stability failures where the app unexpectedly terminates, fails to start, displays a blank screen, or fails on specific phone hardware or OS versions.
include_when: App closes immediately upon opening or crashes back to phone home screen
App hangs on startup with a blank screen
App fails to function after an update or due to OS compatibility (e.g., Android 17, Pixel, OnePlus)
exclude_when: App displays the explicit security error stating it was not downloaded from Play Store
App freezes specifically inside a booking workflow or map view while otherwise operational
example_phrases: Unable to open the app on my phone
closes as soon as I try to open
open and close automatically
app crashed did not open
just keeps giving a blank screen everytime i try to open it
auto updates itself and then the app does not launch
categories.boundary_notes: Covers hard crashes and complete launch failures; recurring Play Store installation source verification dialogs are isolated under PLAY_STORE_VERIFICATION_ERROR.

categories.name: Play Store Verification Error
categories.definition: A specific recurring app blocker where the app falsely claims it was not installed from Google Play Store, forcing users to reinstall.
include_when: App blocks launch with an error dialog stating it was not installed/downloaded from the Play Store
User is forced into recurring cycles of uninstalling and reinstalling due to store verification errors
exclude_when: General app crashes that display no specific store verification message
General download or update failures directly inside the Play Store client
example_phrases: move in synch application can not be installed/opened as it was not downloaded from play store
shows unable to open as the app was not downloaded from play store
showing not installed from play store
in last 3 weeks I uninstall an installed it for 10 times due to the same error
categories.boundary_notes: Separated from general crashes due to its unique recurring signature and root symptom affecting Play Store package verification.

categories.name: Live Tracking and ETA Inaccuracy
categories.definition: Flaws in real-time vehicle map tracking, delayed GPS telemetry, and inaccurate or erratic estimated time of arrival calculations.
include_when: Vehicle GPS pin on the map freezes, lags by minutes, or shows outdated locations
Driver arrives without advance map tracking updates or tracking suddenly appears unannounced
ETA calculation fluctuates wildly (e.g., changes from 5 minutes to 30 minutes) or is vastly inaccurate
exclude_when: Vehicle arrives late due to traffic or driver dispatch delay rather than telemetry/ETA error
Cab routing algorithm schedules an inefficient or circuitous route
example_phrases: Cab Tracker is useless
ETA calculator very bad
doesn't give realtime continuous update on maps
location shows one or two hours ago
suddenly it shows up at your location
Driver arrival shows in 5mins when we leave home changes to 30mins
categories.boundary_notes: Covers digital telemetry and tracking displays; the physical travel trajectory decided by dispatch belongs to ROUTING_AND_PASSENGER_POOLING.

categories.name: Routing and Passenger Pooling
categories.definition: Inefficient automated commute routing, illogical pooling of employees from distant localities into one cab, and unreasonable schedule pickup times.
include_when: System combines passengers traveling to or from opposing directions or different states
Assigned trip route takes significantly longer than standard transit time (e.g., 2+ hours for a 40-minute drive)
Pickups are scheduled with staggered waiting delays for colleagues in the same building
Pickup time is scheduled excessively early relative to shift timing
exclude_when: Driver takes an unauthorized physical shortcut or gets lost on the road
Live vehicle tracking fails to update on the map screen
example_phrases: MoveOutSync doesn't plan commutes it plans cross-country pilgrimages
routing algorithm clubs passengers from two different states
picks the wrong and longer route
club people in a single cab where people are not from the same route
my house is 40min from office it take 2.5 hours
why pick up time too early
categories.boundary_notes: Addresses backend dispatch optimization, co-rider pooling, and travel duration algorithms rather than live tracking telemetry.

categories.name: Booking and Roster Management
categories.definition: Inability to book, schedule, modify, or cancel employee commutes, shuttles, metro passes, or work desks within the app interface.
include_when: App fails or freezes when attempting to book or schedule pick-up and drop rides
Missing or malfunctioning option to cancel a roster schedule or ad-hoc ride
Inability to edit pickup/drop address or addresses mismatching map coordinates
Failures in auxiliary booking modules such as metro QR tickets, shuttles, or seat allocations
exclude_when: User cannot log in or authenticate to access the booking screen
Ride was cancelled externally by vendor or flagged as No Show by driver
example_phrases: unable to schedule pathetic
not able to book cab
there is no option for cancel roster
can't change address
Barely works for metro bookings
unable to book a shuttle
seat number gets removed for bookings
categories.boundary_notes: Focuses on the end-user self-service booking and rostering tools inside the app.

categories.name: UI Friction and Mandatory Prompts
categories.definition: User experience degradation caused by unskippable rating requests, intrusive safety confirmation popups, notification spam, screen brightness overrides, or forced permissions.
include_when: App blocks progression with a compulsory ride rating prompt without a skip option
Seatbelt safety check popup introduces extra clicks or obscures the OTP
Repeated unclosable notification popups blocking UI usage or SOS triggers
App demands unnecessary hardware permissions such as microphone access
App forces phone screen to full brightness without user consent
exclude_when: General non-specific UI complaints with no concrete symptom (NULL_REVIEWS)
Functional errors where booking buttons fail to respond due to network/backend bugs
example_phrases: when you click view otp it pops up the seat belt safely first
forcing me to give rating after every ride as there is no skip option
Too much pop up notification which won't close easily
forcing users to grant microphone access
Goes to full brightness the moment you choose metro ticket
why the hell no option of skip rating
categories.boundary_notes: Addresses deliberate UI flows, modal prompts, and permissions that obstruct seamless application navigation.

categories.name: Driver Conduct and Ground Operations
categories.definition: Failures related to physical transport operations, driver misbehavior, lack of professionalism, unpunctual cab arrivals, and improper no-show declarations.
include_when: Driver exhibits rude, disrespectful, abusive, or unprofessional behavior
Driver arrives excessively late, leaves early, or drops employee before destination
Driver or transport vendor marks rider as 'No Show' without calling or waiting
Cab is not assigned by operational staff despite scheduled booking time
exclude_when: Complaints strictly targeting app software routing algorithms or map GPS updates
User inability to cancel booking due to missing UI buttons
example_phrases: Drivers are rude no professonalism
misbehaved with girl employee
dropped before location
they mark my no show for no reason
cab has to assign on 2:30 am and it's 3:30 am and still no updates
driver will come to pickup point and wait for 1 hour but won't give a short call
categories.boundary_notes: Covers human operational delivery and fleet behavior on the ground rather than software application defects.

categories.name: Helpdesk and Customer Support Defects
categories.definition: Inability to reach transport customer service, unanswered or disconnecting support phone lines, and lack of complaint resolution or feedback channels.
include_when: Helpdesk phone line disconnects automatically or goes unanswered during emergencies
App lacks an accessible customer service, feedback, or grievance escalation channel
Support personnel or transport desk refuse assistance or fail to respond to tickets
exclude_when: Complaints about drivers where customer support was not contacted
Complaints regarding compulsory post-ride star ratings inside the UI
example_phrases: not avle to connect with helpdesk
When trying to reach helpdesk the line disconnects
Customer support they are not receiving the call
no feedback option for routing and journey
transport help team doesn't help at all
no option to contact help desk
categories.boundary_notes: Centers on customer service accessibility, support responsiveness, and dispute resolution channels.

cross_cutting_notes: Update regressions: App updates (notably 12.16.x through 12.19.x) frequently triggered launch crashes, Play Store verification bugs, and degraded user workflows.
Cascading No-Show impact: Telemetry tracking lag, absent driver calls, and app scheduling errors frequently result in riders being falsely penalized with 'No Show' marks.

Safety and compliance friction: Safety-oriented UI features (mandatory seatbelt popups, forced rating gates) counterintuitively create safety risks by obscuring OTPs and impeding SOS emergency accessibility.
